notes: Instrument: tokenledger-llm; the harness report is a reconciliation source only.

The harness report counted every transcript line that carries usage as a request (as recorded in evidence commit d7bf97f: 210,443 requests); one response spans several lines, so its totals were inflated by the line factor. It has since been corrected; ReconLineFactor and ReconCacheReadGapPts replicate the line-counting reader on the frozen requests (tokenledger_log).

Transcript lines are split on newline only. Before 16 Nov 2026 the extractor used str.splitlines(), which also breaks at raw U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 inside JSON strings; 21 usage lines failed to parse and 3 requests were lost (extraction.separator_lines, separator_only_requests).

Not registered: cost_split_sensitivity re-prices the same requests with every cache hit at a flat 0.1x base input, every write at the 5-minute rate, and both; cache reads are the largest cost component in all variants.
Long context: the pricing page lists a prompt-length surcharge only for Claude Haiku 5.5, which does not occur in the data; every model in the data has one rate per token kind.

Its printed cost shares now sum to 1.0000. The runs of 15 Nov 2026 (evidence commits d7bf97f, 3dc01a3) recorded a sum of 0.2133: the model-tier weight sat in the denominator only. The harness has since changed that computation. Not used either way.
List prices weight token kinds and models; they are not the operator's bill (subscription).
